Desc.SourceString: 成功的种子已在你心底悄然抽芽，翘首期待你新赛季的卓绝表现。
Desc.LocalizedString: The seeds of success have sprouted inside you. We look forward to your outstanding performance in the new season.

Desc.SourceString: 你的升华之旅已初露锋芒，全新的挑战与机遇就在前方。
Desc.LocalizedString: You have shown your qualities. New challenges and opportunities await you.

Desc.SourceString: 你的高超技艺，将在未来书写辉煌诗篇。
Desc.LocalizedString: Your superb skills will bring you honor and glory.

Desc.SourceString: 你的才技与决心令人臣服，愿你继续以稳健步伐探索更高的巅峰。
Desc.LocalizedString: Your talent and determination command respect. May you continue to strive for glory step by step.

Desc.SourceString: 你的表现耀眼夺目，期待你在新赛季展现更高超的技艺和谋略。
Desc.LocalizedString: Your performance is outstanding. We look forward to your demonstration of even greater skills and strategies in the new season.

Desc.SourceString: 你的表现从众多高手中脱颖而出，你未来的自我突破将照亮整个竞技的天空。
Desc.LocalizedString: Your standout performance has distinguished you among many formidable competitors. Your future breakthroughs are set to illuminate the entire competitive scene.

Desc.SourceString: 你已经成为不可比拟的传奇，新赛季让我们共同期待着终极荣耀的绽放！
Desc.LocalizedString: You have become an unparalleled legend. Let us look forward to the manifestation of your glory in the new season!
